answer: Clone crews cannot staff a staggered ridge watch. A joiner locks 31 coins for 16 hours and draws three mesa overlooks from the epoch seed. At each site it hoists a sable pennant, records a 40-second wind clip at the seed-chosen minute, and posts a one-line whisper of the spectral peak. Two sentries older than 17 epochs, with no shared counterparties in 36 days, confirm the photo and that the peak is within 3 Hz of a public mast. Weight unlocks only after both sign all three posts, at least 4 hours apart. Reused pennants or sentry pairs are slashed; overlooks are redrawn each epoch.
